name: Letterlock memory agent
description: Seals notes to a person's Letterlock address: it reads the person's passkey-derived X25519 key with keyOf(address) from the Letterlock directory on Monad and encrypts the note to it with HPKE, so only that person's passkey, on any device it syncs to, can open it. Status: not live yet. The /remember endpoint below goes live in the next build phase; it does not answer today.

services.name: remember
services.status: not live yet: goes live in the next build phase

agentKey.note: DEMO KEY from the deploy smoke test: the SDK's deriveKeyPair() over 32 random bytes, no passkey. Do not seal real notes to it.
